# PSIV portable C backend

Unmodified snapshot of the [PSIV project](https://github.com/moritayasuaki/psiv) portable C backend, package version 0.4.0. The source hashes below identify this vendored snapshot independently of later upstream reorganizations. This is the project's handwritten C backend, distinct from its Lean-generated C. The MIT license accompanies these files.

SHA-256:

```text
14b3dbfbfd41c34567bd906017d03bcfc5da309f0726315c95e61bc301a3e3b6  psiv.c
021278bf29849f663ea0ed548de7027275ebc580f26e47279b6ec8083f6e3427  psiv.h
```

The construction is attributed by that project to Tim Beyne, Yu Long Chen, and Michiel Verbauwhede, [A Robust Variant of ChaCha20-Poly1305](https://eprint.iacr.org/2025/222). No author endorsement or security review is claimed. Its separate author-reference source tree is not vendored here.
